faq.q: What quality and format options can I set?
faq.a: Presets for YouTube (1080p 30fps), Smooth motion (1080p 60fps), Small file (720p 24fps), High quality (1440p 60fps) and WhatsApp-friendly, or go Custom. You control resolution (up to 4K), frame rate, and video bitrate (1–20 Mbps) with a live per-minute size estimate. Output format is WebM (VP9/VP8) or MP4 where the browser supports it; it auto-picks the best available.

faq.q: Can I record my voice, system audio and camera together?
faq.a: Yes. Tick microphone for voice-over, system/tab audio (Chrome/Edge only), or both — the two audio sources are mixed into the recording. A camera overlay (picture-in-picture) can be added with position (four corners), size, shape (rounded box, circle or square) and a mirror option; the screen and camera are composited onto a canvas. A live mic level meter confirms audio is captured.

Yes. An optional 3/5/10-second countdown before recording starts, and an auto-stop after 1, 5, 10 or 30 minutes. You can pause and resume into the same file, and a live timer plus running file-size readout show during recording. If you stop screen-sharing from the browser bar, recording ends automatically.

faq.q: Where does the recording go after I stop?
faq.a: It stays on your device — capture is processed locally and nothing is uploaded. You preview the video in-page, then download it (WebM or MP4), save the current frame as a PNG, copy the recording's technical details for a bug report, or discard it. Your capture settings are remembered locally between visits.
